about.title: About and transparency
about.p1: Chennai Universal Commerce compares the total price you would pay (item + delivery + fees − verified coupons) across apps, adjusts ratings for how many reviews they have, and explains every ranking.
about.sample: Right now every price, rating and listing is sample data made for this project. Platform names are used only so the comparisons look realistic. No platform is contacted.
about.tiers: Official APIs and affiliate feeds (tier 1), the ONDC network (tier 2), your own files and prices people report (tier 3), and only where a site allows it, public pages (tier 4). Sources that forbid automated access stay switched off.
about.rules: We never buy for you, never ask for platform passwords or card details, never invent ratings, and never show phone numbers from listings. Affiliate links, if any, are labelled and never change the ranking.
about.checkout: Always check the final price on the platform before paying.
about.privacy: Pincode or locality is enough; we do not ask for your precise location. Alerts store only your email and the alert. You can download or delete them from Saved.
about.sources: See every source and its status

home.headline: Pay less in Chennai.
home.totalBody: Item + delivery + fees + taxes − verified coupons. No surprises at checkout.
home.whyBody: Ratings are adjusted for how many reviews they have, and you can see exactly why an offer is first.
home.trustBody: Prices that look too good, advance-payment requests and copied listings are marked and moved down.
